notes.title: We're participating in the Fall in Love Festival!
notes.notes: [p]Hello! We're happy to announce that our demo is participating in the Fall in Love romance visual novel Festival, organized by Studio Élan. Festival dates are: September 24th-October 1st, 12PM CDT[/p][p][/p][p]Over 200 romance novels from developers around the world are participating in this event. Play the demo and leave your feedback![/p][p][/p][p]Meanwhile, we're continuing to work on the game's main story.[/p]

notes.title: We have passed the first crowdfunding milestone!
notes.notes: [p align="start"]Hello, this is the CopperSnake Studio. We have surpassed 10% of the crowdfunding goal for futher development of The Wondrous Wedding of Ivan the Bard! It may be a small milestone, but it is very important and valuable to us. It shows that there is interest in our project. Thank you, dear backers![/p][p][/p][p]We now continue crowdfunding on [url="https://boomstarter.ru/projects/1182978/videoigra_volshebnaya_svadba_guslyara_ivana"]Boomstarter[/url].[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]We are currently analyzing the demo's launch, summarizing feedback received from players and streamers, deciding improvements and planning further work. The game is expected to have three more chapters and an epilogue. We want to add more interactivity, choices, and plot branches so that the visual novel truly feels like an interactive adventure, rather than just, well, a novel :)[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]We are also preparing gifts for the backers. Here is one of them: a thank-you letter on birch bark! We couldn’t get real birch bark, although we really wanted to, but we prepared letters on beautiful paper that mimics birch bark, with a stylized font. Each inscription will be unique, including the backer’s name. The letter will be sealed in a kraft envelope.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45602365/85019e83b74b64a94e21a5411a2ff56423d31aa4.jpg"][/img][/p][p align="start"]Thank you for your support![/p]

notes.title: An updated demo with professional voice acting has been released!
notes.notes: [p]Hello! We have released an updated version of the demo. The main innovation is that it now has professional multi-voice acting from the Ninofilm studio![/p][p][/p][p]In addition, the following changes have been made:[/p][list][*][p]English translation inaccuracies have been corrected[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]A new font has been added to the English version[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]The quick menu and rollback buttons have been slightly repositioned[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]The contrast of sprites and backgrounds has been increased[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: We have launched crowdfunding. Back us!
notes.notes:
The prologue of our game is released, and you can play it right now!

To fund further development, we have launched crowdfunding on the Boomstarter platform. If you enjoyed the beginning of the story, please help us finish it by [url=https://boomstarter.ru/projects/1182978/videoigra_volshebnaya_svadba_guslyara_ivana]participating in the crowdfunding[/url].

A successful crowdfunding campaign will help us create about five hours of gameplay, including three chapters and an epilogue, add many characters, choices, and CG art, as well as musical mini-games.

Please back the game, and then "The Wondrous Wedding" will truly come to life!

Go to [url=https://boomstarter.ru/projects/1182978/videoigra_volshebnaya_svadba_guslyara_ivana]Boomstarter[/url].

notes.title: We have finished recording the demo voiceover!
notes.notes: Ninofilm studio has completed the main voiceover work for the prologue of the novel The Wondrous Wedding of Ivan the Bard. Currently, mixing and editing are in progress. In the second half of June, the full Russian voiceover will be available in the prologue. Stay tuned for updates!
